rows.grounds: ablative of abhiṣeka plus enclitic tu
fused accusative of the threefold tejas
compound denoting the goddess's own nature

items.question: How does the threefold tejas become the goddess's own nature through abhiṣeka?
items.inference: Abhiṣeka converts the worshipped threefold tejas into the goddess's essential nature.
uncertainties: exact internal sandhi of abhiṣekāttu is not expanded in the row
items.plain_english: By abhiṣeka, that threefold tejas becomes the goddess's own nature.
